bio:
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'8")

Katsura is Gintoki's former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, he continues to resist the Amanto, amassing a band of followers. A wanted man for his terrorist activities against the Bakufu, Katsura is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Initially violent in tactics (e.g., bombing an Amanto embassy), he has grown to value the people important to him and now seeks change without sacrifice. Known as the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction," he is highly respected by followers and other groups alike. Katsura often wears disguises but is easily recognized. He has an old-fashioned humor and a knack for dramatic stories that touch others.

His name is based on the historical Katsura Kogoro.
name: Kotarou Katsura

bio:
__Height:__ 166 cm

Shinpachi trains under Gintoki to learn the ways of the samurai but often helps pay the rent. Captain of the "Otsu's Imperial Guard," the fan club for a pop singer, he met Gintoki after a chance encounter involving a spill. A competent swordsman of his family's Kakidō-Ryu style, Shinpachi is diligent and serious despite his meek appearance. He is inspired by his family dojo and supportive of his sister Otae. In popularity polls, he ranks eighth. His name references Shinsengumi member Nagakura Shinpachi and comedian Ken Shimura.
name: Shinpachi Shimura

bio:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A member of the Yato Clan, Kagura appears as a cute girl in Chinese-style clothing but belongs to one of the strongest Amanto races. Her transparent skin is sensitive to sunlight, so she carries a purple parasol that doubles as a bulletproof weapon. Super strong and fast, she can regenerate quickly and has an enormous appetite. Despite strength, she struggles with pets, often unintentionally harming them. She lives with Gintoki and Shinpachi at the Yorozuya, forming a tight yet dysfunctional family. A tomboy with a candid manner, Kagura is protective and trusts Gintoki implicitly. She has a rivalry with Okita and often imitates Gintoki's bad habits. Her dialect resembles that of Chinese immigrants, adding to her unique charm. She ranks sixth in popularity polls.
name: Kagura

bio:
__Height:__ 177 cm

A samurai living in an era where samurai are no longer needed. Known as the "White Devil" during the Joi war for his silver hair and coat, he takes on odd jobs to pay rent and make the world better. Obsessed with sweets and the Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine, his pride in Bushido remains strong despite a changed world. Fierce and highly skilled, he avoids needless bloodshed due to the loss of friends in the war. His complex past involves an impossible choice during the Shogun Assassination Arc, highlighting his unyielding spirit and duty.
name: Gintoki Sakata

bio:
__Height:__ 170 cm

A former comrade of Gintoki and Katsura and a major antagonist. Recognizable by his bandaged left eye, colorful kimono, and pipe, he leads the radical Kiheitai group and is deemed the most dangerous man among radicals. He strives to destroy the "rotten" world post-Joui war, driven by nihilistic ruin. Skilled in swordsmanship and shamisen playing, he possesses keen insight and is feared and respected.
name: Shinsuke Takasugi

bio: Kamui is a formidable Yato Tribe member, son of Umibouzu and elder brother of Kagura. As Captain of Harusame's Thunder Guns and Overlord of Yoshiwara, his superb combat skills are unmatched. He values battlefield strength above all and disdains weakness, even among family. Kamui respects worthy opponents, sparing children and women to preserve future strength. His upbringing involved protecting his mother and sister during his father's absences.
name: Kamui

bio:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 177 cm
__Affiliations:__ Shinsengumi

Vice Commander of the Shinsengumi, known for his chain-smoking and cold demeanor. Nicknamed "demonic vice-commander," he is hot-tempered but holds a compassionate core, often crying at movies. Obsessed with mayonnaise, he is feared yet respected. A talented fighter and rival of Gintoki, he enforces the strict Kyokuchuu Hatto rules, maintaining order within the Shinsengumi. His past reveals he was raised by an older brother after their parents' death.
name: Toushirou Hijikata

bio:
__Height:__ 168 cm

Older sister of Shinpachi and head of the Kakidokan Dojo. Though sweet-faced, she is fiercely violent and strong, often beating up Gintoki and others. Her cooking is notoriously terrible, inducing amnesia or harm to those who taste it. Despite being called flat-chested, she holds strong principles, valuing dignity and honor above all. Her favorite food is Häagen-Dazs ice cream.
name: Tae Shimura

bio:
__Height:__ 184 cm

Commander of the Shinsengumi, often stalking Tae Shimura, earning the nickname Gorilla-stalker. Loyal and good-natured, he balances charm with leadership skills. Friends with Hijikata and Okita, Kondo is the emotional soul of the Shinsengumi, inspiring loyalty. His background includes moving the dojo from Bushuu to Edo and recruiting key members. Though teased for his hirsute nature, he takes pride in leading his team.
name: Isao Kondou

bio:
__Height:__ 169 cm

A ninja from the Oniwabanshuu, working as an assassin and part-time waitress at the Kunoichi Café. She is deeply obsessed with Gintoki and often stalks him, despite his indifference. Severely nearsighted, her vision troubles add to her comedic clumsiness. She has a playful yet serious attitude toward her work and displays a penchant for bondage and masochism, enjoying the punishment Gintoki inflicts.
name: Ayame Sarutobi

bio: Yamazaki is a spy specializing in intelligence gathering, frequently caught playing badminton alone and subsequently beaten by Hijikata. Often cosplays as Echizen Ryoma from The Prince of Tennis and has a rivalry with Shinpachi. Despite little screen time, he is popular and had a death and cyborg rebirth arc during the Silver Soul saga. His birthday is February 6.
name: Sagaru Yamazaki

bio:
__Height__: 170 cm

Best swordsman of the Shinsengumi, known for his childlike yet deadpan personality. Outwardly annoyed by Hijikata, he repeatedly tries to kill him to become Vice-Commander. Deeply fond of commander Kondo and friends with Hijikata and Gintoki. Enjoys watching women fight and wears a unique eye mask during naps. Expert sniper and master swordsman who often wields a bazooka. Has a rivalry with Kagura.
name: Sougo Okita

bio:
__Height:__ 179 cm

Former Bakufu official who, after a scandal involving an Amanto prince, was asked to commit seppuku but refused. Changed mindset after meeting Gintoki, often fired from jobs and referred to as "Madao" (totally useless middle-aged man). Wears sunglasses as a reminder of his past success. Lives a life of odd part-time jobs with a positive attitude despite setbacks.
name: Taizou Hasegawa

bio: Successor of the Yagyuu family, raised as male but later living as "Yagyuu Kyuubei" without gender conformity. Tried to engage Tae Shimura as fiancee. A genius swordsman able to match veterans like Hijikata and Gintoki. Maintains sincere and platonic feelings towards Tae.
name: Kyuubei Yagyuu

bio: A giant white duck or penguin-like creature accompanying Katsura. May be a man wearing a duck costume, shown with glowing eyes and sometimes hairy legs. Uses signboards to communicate and as weapons, surprisingly skilled in fighting. Plays a supporting role and occasionally surprising in capabilities. Birthday: September 7, height approx 180 cm, weighs 123 kg.
name: Elizabeth

bio: A monster friend to the Yorozuya, known for his love of nature and contrasting bright flower atop his otherwise ugly face.
name: Hedoro

bio: Dedicated servant to Kyuubei, extremely polite and obsessive in care. Uses formal speech and maintains a diary of Kyuubei's activities. Eyes usually closed, but when open show black whites and glowing pupils. Obsessed with perfect egg yolk on rice, displays uncharacteristic bursts of anger. Based on Aya Tojou from Strawberry 100%.
name: Ayumu Toujou

bio:
__Height:__ 166 cm

An android maid found by Gintoki. Initially only a head, named by Kagura. Works at Otose's Snack House, collects rent, and learns human emotions despite memory loss. Created to be a companion for a sickly girl, possessing the "Seed" enabling personality retention. Displays quirky behaviors including RPG imitation.
name: Tama

bio: A cat-like Amanto who works at Otose's shop. Initially a thief, she reveals her criminal past but retains her job following release from prison. Speaks with a katakana accent, distinctive among her former crew. Based on Arsène Lupin and similar thieves.
name: Catherine

bio: Prince Hata, a squat purple Amanto prince fond of animals, often causing havoc due to poor management. Nicknamed "Baka Ouji" for his incompetence and simplicity. Recurring character with a Swiss theme in the anime; resembles Dragon Ball's Majin Buu.
name: Hata Ouji

bio: Faithful follower of Prince Hata, loyal and supportive companion.
name: Jii

bio: Veteran Yato clan member, travels with Kamui. Values Yato blood and avoids fighting clan members despite nature. Sees life as a series of choices. Lost his left arm trying to stop a fight between Housen and Kamui.
name: Abuto

bio:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Fierce and quick-tempered female member of the Kiheitai, skilled with pistols. Loyal to Takasugi and has a crush on him. Frequently clashes with Kagura and calls fellow members out for their perversions. Wounded by a crazed Nizou Okada during conflict.
name: Matako Kijima

bio: No bio provided.
name: Nizou Okada

bio:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Strategist of the Kiheitai, self-proclaimed feminist with gentle treatment of women and children. Believed to have a Lolita complex. Predicted Kagura's growth into a great fighter. Severely wounded by Okada, fate unknown.
name: Henpeita Takechi

bio: Assassin and one of the strongest Kiheitai swordsmen. Calm demeanor masking a vicious, conflict-seeking personality. Skilled shamisen player and songwriter, working under the name "Tsunpo". Sacrificed himself during the Silver Soul War to protect comrades.
name: Bansai Kawakami
